exposure: previous hospital stay longer than two days
cohort: Consenting patients hospitalized in postoperative care wards, ICUs, or neonatal wards across three hospitals in Bobo Dioulasso, Burkina Faso, excluding those with pre-existing infection, cancer, or immunosuppression.
finding: The cumulative incidence rate of healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) was 25%, with surgical site infections and neonatal infections being the most common, and HAIs were associated with longer hospitalization and increased mortality.
followup_time: Variable, during hospitalization within the 7-month study period (May 1 to November 30, 2022)
